subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Should this PR require visible real gateway/Telegram generated-media wake-false proof, or is the internal scheduler plus Mantis `fixed: true` evidence acceptable for this draft?
rationale: The normal external PR proof gate requires after-fix real behavior evidence, but the discussion says normal Telegram Desktop cannot expose this internal path and asks maintainers to choose the proof bar.

options.title: Require stacked visible proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the proof stack or equivalent hook shows baseline miss/block and candidate exactly-one image delivery in a real channel setup.

options.title: Accept internal-path proof
options.body: Treat the scheduler matrix and Mantis internal `fixed: true` result as sufficient for this rare internal recovery path.

options.title: Pause until harness lands
options.body: Keep this PR draft until the separate proof harness provides a stable proof stimulus.

recommendation.title: Require stacked visible proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until the proof stack or equivalent hook shows baseline miss/block and candidate exactly-one image delivery in a real channel setup.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the introduced recovery split and adjacent committed route backfill, making them the best available owner for the proof-sufficiency choice.
